title: Tuki 1736 (Missale Copto-Arabicum): Bohairic Coptic St. Basil Anaphora core constituent — complete constituent extent and page account
scope: Complete Bohairic Coptic column of the St. Basil Anaphora core in Raphael Tuki's 1736 Rome Missale Copto-Arabicum (ULB Bonn digital copy, Part II printed pp. 96-116 / PDF pp. 389-409): from the Anaphora heading ⲦⲀⲚⲀⲪⲞⲢⲀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲂⲀⲤⲒⲖⲒⲞⲤ ⲙ̀ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ and Opening Dialogue on II.96 (PDF p. 389), through Preface, printed Pre-Sanctus hymns, Sanctus, Post-Sanctus, Institution Narrative of Bread and Cup (including Ⲁϥϫⲉⲙϯⲡⲓ 'He tasted' at II.110 / PDF p. 403), Anamnesis, and Epiclesis (including Tuki's printed Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅ at II.114 / PDF p. 407) through the concluding communion-fruits petition Ⲁⲣⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲙⲡ̀ϣⲁ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ ... ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛⲉϩ. on II.116 (PDF p. 409) immediately before the Great Intercessions (Ⲁⲣⲓⲫⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...). Excludes the parallel Arabic translation column, Arabic-only rubrics, running heads, page numerals, catchwords, and later blue/purple manuscript reader annotations.

pages.description: Title, Part I incense offices, and Part II Ordo Communis (including Arabic Creed pp. 378-380) through II.95.
II.96 (PDF p. 389): St. Basil Anaphora title and Opening Dialogue (Coptic left column only).
II.97 (PDF p. 390): Completion of Opening Dialogue and opening of Preface (Ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧϣⲟⲡ...).
II.98 (PDF p. 391): Continuation of Preface (angelic choirs).
II.99 (PDF p. 392): End of Preface (cherubim/seraphim) and start of printed pre-Sanctus hymns.
II.100-102 (PDF pp. 393-395): Printed pre-Sanctus hymns (Greek-in-Coptic and Bohairic Coptic alternatives).
II.103 (PDF p. 396): Sanctus and opening of Post-Sanctus (Ⲭⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲭⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲭⲟⲩⲁⲃ...).
II.104-105 (PDF pp. 397-398): Post-Sanctus salvation history (Fall, Incarnation, Cross, Resurrection, Ascension).
II.106 (PDF p. 399): End of Post-Sanctus (Judgment, Kata to eleos) and opening of Institution Narrative (Ⲁϥⲭⲱ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲁⲛ...).
II.107-110 (PDF pp. 400-403): Bread Institution Narrative (ⲪⲀⲒ ⲄⲀⲢ ⲠⲈ ⲠⲀⲤⲰⲘⲀ) and Cup preparation through Ⲁϥϫⲉⲙϯⲡⲓ ('He tasted').
II.111 (PDF p. 404): Cup Institution Narrative (ⲪⲀⲒ ⲄⲀⲢ ⲠⲈ ⲠⲀⲤⲚⲞϤ...) and start of Anamnesis (Ⲥⲟⲡ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ...).
II.112-113 (PDF pp. 405-406): Anamnesis dialogue (Ton thanaton sou / Se ainoumen), Ⲉⲛⲓⲣⲓ ⲟⲩⲛϩⲱⲛ, oblation, and Ⲧⲉⲛϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ.
II.114-116 (PDF pp. 407-409): Epiclesis (Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ Ⲡⲭ̅ⲥ̅...), bread/cup transformations, and communion-fruits petition ending before Ⲁⲣⲓⲫⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅.
Great Intercessions, Fraction, Gregory and Cyril Anaphoras, errata leaves (pp. 667-671) and colophon (p. 672).
